list: This is discussed on the talk page. The first one should be always successful only if the player receives an axe & tinderbox and/or chops a log and/or makes a fire. If the player uses another player's fire to cook a shrimp before doing any of that, the shrimp can be burnt with a 50% chance as before; if the shrimp is successfully cooked, the player can skip the woodcutting and firemaking part of the tutorial.
Values have been changed since citation's date, corresponding newspost is implicit about updated values.
It is unclear if an inconsistent delay after mining a dark essence block actually exists – the process appears always to take 9 ticks, even before the 7 December 2022 Mining delay removals.
